description: Read the result of an Evolize assessment started with scan_website, using the scan_handle it returned. Read-only: it never starts a scan, never refreshes an assessment, never changes publication state, and never consumes scan quota — polling is safe. While the assessment is pending it returns the status and a retry_after_seconds. Follow next_cursor to read every finding.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response's `next_cursor`. Omit for the first page.

scan_handle.description: The opaque handle returned by scan_website.

name: get_scan_result
title: Read an assessment result
